_comment: Quests: ordered stages with journal entries. A stage with "done": true completes the quest and gives every living member its xp. "auto_if" stages are reached on their own when the condition holds. See docs/NPCS_AND_QUESTS.md.

stages.journal: Aldous Grey, the reeve, lost an iron key somewhere around the village well. It opens the strongbox where Millbrook keeps its taxes.
We found the reeve's key lying on the cobbles near the well.
We gave the key back to the reeve, who paid us 40 gold.

wennas_remedy.name: A Draught for the Miller's Wife

stages.journal: Wenna the herbalist gave us a fever draught for Merra, the miller's wife. Hob the miller lives in the thatched cottage west of the square.
Hob took the draught for Merra and gave us 20 gold for our trouble.
Father Anselm needs a hooded lantern to replace the cracked lamp on the temple altar. Tobin at the Lantern & Thistle sells them.
We gave the temple a lantern. Father Anselm blessed us with a potion of greater healing.

the_undying_lantern.name: The Lantern That Never Goes Out

stages.journal: Pip the bard sang of a lantern hidden somewhere in these hills that has burned since before Millbrook was built. It is what Elowen came here to find.
